design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §4.2 (core_score 40% 动量 block; 缺分量→中性) / §4.0 (两遍打分) / §18.2 (跨模块共享契约先 schema-first 冻结再消费) / §19
authorization_note: OFFLINE cross-module glue contract SHAPE only. This seam is pure projection: it consumes the batch5 momentum PRODUCER result (engine/us_short_momentum.py::momentum_block) and emits the batch4 score-composer input (a per-ticker §4.2 40% momentum block scalar, or a neutral-fill disposition). It fetches nothing, scores nothing, re-runs no producer, and selects no provider. Live provider fetch of the daily series that feeds the producer stays gated under SR-PROVIDER-001. This binding freezes BOTH sides of the new shared contract — the accepted producer-result shape, the projection output shape, the coverage partition policy, and the disposition vocabulary — so nothing can silently drift before Cut 6 composition consumes it.
consumer_ref: batch4 score composer -> engine/us_short_weekend_analysis.py score_blocks['momentum'] -> engine/us_short_core_score.py
identity_policy: engine/us_short_eligibility_gate.py::canonical_us_ticker; one canonical identity per stock; plain str only (a str subclass is rejected before any method dispatch)
numeric_value_note: a momentum block value must be an EXACT built-in int/float (bool, numeric string, numpy/other numeric subclass, and any object with a hostile __float__/__le__/__ge__ are ALL rejected) that is finite and within block_value_domain; the projected value is a plain float. momentum_block computes plain-float percentiles, so exact-type is the correct + strictest contract — it closes the whole numeric-subclass dunder class at the boundary (no __float__/__le__ dispatch on an untrusted value).

coverage_partition_policy.matrix_identity: coverage_matrix keys (canonical) must EXACTLY equal the union of momentum_block ∪ insufficient_history ∪ insufficient_coverage identities — no missing, no extra, no contradictory
coverage_partition_policy.history_relation: a ticker in insufficient_history has n_present == 0
coverage_partition_policy.insufficient_coverage_relation: a ticker in insufficient_coverage has 0 < n_present < min_coverage
coverage_partition_policy.duplicate_policy: reject a post-canonical duplicate within EVERY identity-bearing collection (momentum_block keys, coverage_matrix keys, insufficient_history, insufficient_coverage); never silently set-collapse
coverage_partition_policy.sub_feature_relation: sub_feature_coverage keys must exactly equal sub_feature_universe; each count is an exact int in [0, number_of_identities]
coverage_partition_policy.min_coverage_rule: min_coverage is an exact int in [1, len(sub_feature_universe)]
coverage_partition_policy.n_present_bound: each coverage_matrix n_present is an exact int in [0, len(sub_feature_universe)]
coverage_partition_policy.margin_conservation: Σ coverage_matrix n_present (row degrees) == Σ sub_feature_coverage counts (column degrees) — both count the same ticker×sub-feature incidence cells
coverage_partition_policy.margin_realizability: the row-degree (per-ticker n_present) and column-degree (per-sub_feature count) sequences must be jointly realizable as a binary ticker×sub-feature incidence matrix (Gale-Ryser)

neutral_fill_note: a target ticker that is insufficient_history / insufficient_coverage / absent_from_pool is NOT scored — it is reported in neutral_fill_tickers so the composer OMITS the momentum block and core_score applies the §4.2 neutral-block rule (never a fabricated momentum value).
